answer: Epoch Trajectory Reputation Floor. Each identity's daily behavioural fingerprint (action mix, timing entropy, counterparty overlap) is snapshotted per epoch; at each dawn the system compares the new snapshot against a rolling median of prior epochs. An identity whose similarity drops below the score's historical nadir triggers a rebuild penalty: its trust weighting resets and it must re-earn standing across several clean epochs before regaining full reach.
